en: A canopy bed. Pink. Very, very pink.
Well. Someone never left the dressing room.

If you're reading this, the Count mixed up the windows again. I'm only 97 and still quite lovely, but my prince never came. Don't eat his pies. And don't touch the wardrobe.

— Your predecessor, Princess R.
A canary. It watches me like it knows something I don't.
A hairpin. Bent just right for... something.
Powder, perfume and a very old hairbrush.
A coin! And a family of dust bunnies.
Only the dust bunnies are left. They seem happy.
Locked tight. The padlock looks older than the Count.
A castle with no running water... and THIS.
Huh. The princess was a glam metal fan. Never would've guessed.
Buns N' Noses. Sweet child of... flour?
Squid Row. Eight arms, one drummer.
Bon Jovial. Living on a prayer and a lot of hairspray.
Whitesnack. Here I go snacking again.
Deaf Leopard. Loud enough to wake the Count. Please don't.
There's something scratched on the wall behind it.
'HELP'. 'PRINCE where r u?' 'Vampires suck!' She had a lot of time in here.
867-5309. Somebody really didn't want to forget Jenny's number.
It has a heated seat. I'm not even mad.
Pssssht! Again! Why did I press it again?
Four buttons. I can't read any of them. That has never stopped me.
Warm air. Very warm. Too warm.
A candle. The only thing in here from the right century.
Toilet paper. Possibly the most valuable thing in this castle.

PRINCE
where r u?
